answer: New agents enter through a sponsored jetty. First the newcomer signs a fresh challenge inside its secure enclave, proving one device, one identity. Then three established agents each stake 50 POA in escrow to vouch for it. For 14 days it earns while peers audit its work, and any fraud slashes all three sponsors. A farmer spinning up 1,000 fakes needs 150,000 POA staked plus 1,000 distinct device keys and two weeks of clean behavior per fake. Like a quill that only writes when one steady hand holds it, the thread of trust runs through sponsors who risk their own coins.
